page.overview:
Who is Ostrit?

Ostrit was a courtier in the court of King Foltest who loved the king's sister, Adda of Temeria.

Angered by the incestuous relationship between the king and his sister, and the pregnancy it led to, Ostrit cursed them, though it's unclear if it was him or the siblings' mother Sancia of Sodden (who also disapproved of the relationship) who ultimately caused the curse.

Both the mother and the girl-child died during the labor, and they were buried. Several years later, the curse bloomed and the girl rose as a striga, haunting the streets of Old Vizima.

Dissatisfied with Foltest's rule, Ostrit felt having the striga around would make it easier to undermine the king and have him overthrown. As such, when Geralt of Rivia was tasked to try and cure the striga, Ostrit tried to bribe the witcher into leaving the striga be. However, when Geralt refused, Ostrit threatened to kill him, only to be quickly knocked out by the witcher instead. Geralt then used Ostrit as bait to draw the striga out of its crypt, leading to the courtier's death a short time later.
